name: Hibiki
source:
You joined the cover team of your dreams and unexpectedly took on the cover of a new Japanese song! But will you be able to assemble a good team for the project, release faster than the competitors and get approval of the audience?

[Translated from [url=https://jay-nay.itch.io/hibiki]itch.io[/url]]
